paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.42% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+2.78%) and Nasdaq weakest (-2.18%). Brent crude changed -2.24% to 114.11. Gold changed -2.64% to 3,902.1001. Bitcoin changed -3.71% to 77,051.2812. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.952%, a relative move of -0.72%. Among the firms tracked, Evercore (+14.30%) and Santander (-12.62%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: CD&R pursues buyout of $40bn card processor Global Payments (FT World). Deal for US company would rank among largest buyouts in history Deals and capital markets: Partners plans to halve withdrawal limits on strained private equity fund (FT Markets). Swiss firm is under pressure as clients pull their money from its largest US and European funds Central banks and macro: Israeli central bank rejects Netanyahu’s plan to use crypto to evade sanctions (FT World). Critics say prime minister’s proposal would turn country into an economic pariah Central banks and macro: Bank of Japan says 2% inflation goal reached after decades of deflation (FT World). Japanese central bank holds interest rates as expectations mount for December increase Geopolitics and trade: European oil majors lift buybacks as Iran war drives bumper profits (FT Markets). Shell boss says he does not want surplus cash to ‘burn a hole in our pockets’
